status: TN-1/TN-2 FROZEN before the stage-4 pilot (precondition P-3); any change re-opens its measurement as a new registered evaluation (docs/REDOCRED_MAIN_RUN_DESIGN.md §3.1). TN-3/TN-4/TN-5 ADOPTED 2026-10-29 as version 2 under registered evaluation RE-TN-1 (conformance entry DC-6): the extended layers apply to the EXTENDED figure only, the v1 figure is always computed under TN-1/TN-2 alone and reported beside it (see effect_reporting).

source_payload.derivation: TN-1 and TN-2 are transcribed mechanically from the payload's direction / inverse_of declarations; the scorer's proof script asserts the table equals the payload's declarations

matching_normalization: same document; endpoint strings compared casefolded with whitespace collapsed (the audit's rule); direction as annotated except where TN-1/TN-2 canonicalize
tn1_rule: for these declared-symmetric types, endpoint order is ignored in matching (the schema's own semantics, applied deliberately)

tn2_inverse_pairs.inverse: located in the administrative territorial entity

tn2_primary_rule: primary = the alphabetically first label of the pair, frozen here as the pair's canonical representative; a triple stated under the inverse label is canonicalized to (object, primary, subject) before matching, on BOTH the extracted and the gold side

CONTAINMENT: located in the administrative territorial entity

tn3_rule: RE-TN-1 (extended figure only): a record or gold triple stated under any member label also matches under the group label. Keys are ADDITIVE — the verbatim label's keys are always retained, so grouping can never break a TN-2 pairing. Group labels are scorer-side only and are never emitted, stored, or claimed as relations. For the extended figure this supersedes the never_map refusals covering the member-of family, the located/location family, and capital-vs-headquarters proximity; the frozen figure still applies never_map in full.
tn4_rule: RE-TN-1 (extended figure only): a GOLD relation also matches predicted records stated under each listed additional inverse label, with endpoints swapped. These pairs carry no inverse_of declaration in the schema (the direction_declarations artefact records that gap for father/mother/child); TN-4 fills it as scoring data for the extended figure only — it does not amend the artefact, and the frozen figure never expands direction this way (see the never_map direction rule).
tn5_rule: RE-TN-1 (extended figure only): a GOLD containment relation also matches a predicted record stated as 'capital of' (a capital stated for a place is evidence of the containment the gold records), same direction, endpoints unswapped. One-way only: a gold 'capital of' gains no containment keys.

never_map.rule: distinct properties that merely share an endpoint pattern — never equated
distinct properties — never equated (basin country likewise stays distinct)
the member-of family: the generic and its specializations are never equated

labels: located in the administrative territorial entity

never_map.rule: direction on any directed type outside TN-2's joint label+direction canonical form is never normalized away
a demonym adjective endpoint never normalizes into a place

effect_reporting: raw and TN figures are both printed wherever either appears; the TN delta is a labeled line, never folded into the corrected-precision figure
